Definition: Jehojarib, the name of two Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Jehoiarib is the name of two Israelites, a priest of the first course and a priest of Jerusalem. In 1 Chronicles 9:10, Jehoiarib, and Jachin. The fuller story is told on the Jehoiarib, Course Head profile in Biblical People.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that Jehoiarib shows me God keeps His promises across generations, even through flawed families.
